question.text: What will Anthropic (ANT) close at on Friday, November 27, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the closing price, in US dollars, of Anthropic, PBC Class A common stock (ticker ANT, Nasdaq Global Select Market) for the trading session of Friday, 27 November 2026, as shown in the "Close" column of the row dated 27 November 2026 on the Yahoo Finance historical prices page for ANT: https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANT/history/. For example, a reported close of 94.20 resolves to 94.20. If Yahoo Finance does not display a closing price for that date, the Nasdaq historical quotes page for ANT (https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/ant/historical) will be used instead, and failing that, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions).
question.fine_print: Friday, 27 November 2026 is a shortened Nasdaq trading session with a 1:00 p.m. ET early close; the official closing price of that abbreviated session is the value used. If ANT has not commenced trading on Nasdaq by 27 November 2026, or if no closing price for that date can be found in any of the sources listed above, the question is annulled.

research:
Research findings: the question cannot be settled yet. ANT has not priced or started trading as of 2026-11-17.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-17: The Yahoo Finance ANT history page shows "Anthropic, PBC (ANT) … Pending IPO Price" and "There are no [prices] in the selected time period." It has no data rows. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANT/history/)
- I did not try the Nasdaq fallback page. No exchange price exists until the debut on 2026-11-19.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled. Pricing is expected on 2026-11-18 and the first trade on 2026-11-19. That leaves 6 sessions through 11-27: Nov 19, 20, 23, 24, 25 and the half day on Nov 27. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-ipo-claude-maker-to-begin-trading-on-thursday-nov-19-173550865.html)
- One search summary notes that the 11-18/11-19 dates are widely reported but "not stated in the filing." [search summary](https://pomegra.io/news/anthropic-ipo-ant-prices-wednesday-at-up-to-14t-value)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-17: Berenberg expects more than $19bn of passive buying in the first month. Intropic puts this at about 29% of IPO share volume. Berenberg says ANT is "a mirror image of the SpaceX IPO," with index-related drivers over the first 15 trading days. [hket](https://inews.hket.com/article/4226205/anthropic-stock-indexe), [Khaleej Times](https://www.khaleejtimes.com/business/from-spacex-to-anthropic-markets-have-a-new-playbook-for-mega-share-debuts?amp=1)
- 2026-11-16: The Nasdaq fell about 2.5%, the S&P about 1.9% and the Dow about 1.4%. Nvidia fell about 4%, chip export curbs weighed on the sector, and Nvidia's Q3 results are due around 11-17. Vanda estimates net retail buying of about $250m on day one, more than double the SpaceX record. Vanda also warns that buying ANT may mean selling other AI stocks. [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-16-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-oil-091631084.html)
- About 2026-11-16: Altimeter's Brad Gerstner reportedly called the deal 10 to 20 times oversubscribed and plans a $5bn order. This is secondhand and unverified. [BeInCrypto](https://beincrypto.com/how-to-buy-anthropic-ipo-ant-shares/)
- 2026-11-12: Bloomberg reported orders at about 6 times the shares on offer. There is a 123.75m-share over-allotment option. Seven strategic investors (Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft, TSMC) are buying $26bn of non-voting Class N shares at the IPO price. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262304476-anthropic-ipo-ant-price-above-78-orders-six-times-november-14-2026-tradingkey)
- 2026-11-10: The price range is $70 to $78. Bankers were weighing pricing above the range and a valuation of $1.5T or more. I found no confirmed range increase. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-10/anthropic-targets-64-4-billion-ipo-nearing-spacex-s-record)
- Share-count conversion (my arithmetic): $1.404T ÷ $78 is about 18.0bn fully diluted shares, so $1.25T is about $69 a share and $1.5T about $83. Valued on outstanding shares only, the range is about $0.92T to $1.02T. [search summary](https://www.tradingview.com/symbols/NASDAQ-ANT/)

## 4. Base rates and comparables
- SpaceX (June 2026) is the closest comparable: a mega-IPO with Nasdaq-100 fast entry.
  - It priced at $135, opened at $150 and closed day one at $160.95, up 19%. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/12/spacex-ipo-closes-up-19-and-delivers-the-worlds-first-trillionaire/)
  - By the end of week one (06-19) it was about $185, up 37%, after a reported intraday high near $225. One blog conflicts and says about $156. [BGOV](https://news.bgov.com/capital-markets/spacex-extends-two-day-drop-a-week-after-largest-ever-ipo-2)
  - On 06-22 it fell to $155, and it later slid toward $135. Swings of 15 to 20% within a few sessions were normal. [search result](https://www.nasdaq.com/articles/why-spacex-stock-soared-today), [GadgetReview](https://www.gadgetreview.com/spacex-stock-slides-toward-its-135-ipo-price-for-a-second-straight-day)
- Nasdaq-100 fast entry (rule in effect since 2026-05-01): a new listing is tested at the close of its 7th trading day and the addition is announced after the 10th. For ANT, day 7 would be about 11-30 and the actual inclusion lands after 11-27. Early positioning buying is still expected before then. [search results](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/anthropic-ipo-expected-to-enter-nasdaq-100-within-weeks)
- There is no seasonal pattern that applies. The Thanksgiving half-day session is usually thin.

## 5. Other forecasts and market-implied prices
- Hyperliquid pre-IPO perpetual contracts:
  - About 11-16: $98.67, about 26% above $78. [BeInCrypto](https://beincrypto.com/how-to-buy-anthropic-ipo-ant-shares/)

  - Track record: the SpaceX perpetual was about $172.84 the day before listing, against a day-one close of $160.95, so it overshot.
- Polymarket, IPO-day move (11-17 prices; these buckets do not sum to 1 and look illiquid or stale): down more than 10%: 0.23; down 0 to 10%: 0.17; up 0 to 10%: 0.355; up 10 to 20%: 0.30; up 20 to 30%: 0.415; up 30 to 50%: 0.26.
- Polymarket, IPO-day closing market cap (11-16, more than $7m traded): below $1.25T: 21.1¢; $1.25T to $1.5T: 43.8¢. The share-count basis is unclear. [Deadspin](https://deadspin.com/prediction-markets/trending/what-will-anthropics-ipo-closing-cap-be-when-the-company-goes-public/)
- Manifold has an IPO-day closing cap market; I did not retrieve its prices. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Jack1/anthropic-ipo-day-closing-market-ca)
- I found no Kalshi or Polymarket market on the 11-27 price specifically.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 11-17 (after the close): Nvidia Q3 earnings, the main near-term driver for the AI trade. I could not find results yet.
- 11-18: final offer price. Watch for pricing above $78 or an upsized deal.
- 11-19: first trade. The greenshoe and underwriter price support can hold the stock near the offer price.
- 11-20 to 11-25: index-related positioning. Any VIX spike (about 21 on 11-13) would matter, as would US chip export-rule news.
- 11-26: market holiday. 11-27: half-day session ending at 1 p.m. ET.

# ANT close on 27 Nov 2026: research brief (as of 2026-11-17)

**Bottom line:** ANT has not traded yet and the IPO has not been priced. Nothing settles the question. The two main anchors are the $70-78 range, with pricing on Nov 18, and SpaceX's June debut. The one market priced in dollars puts its median day-one value at about $1.25-1.5T. Very roughly, that is $69-83 per share on a fully diluted basis, but the share count Polymarket uses is unknown.

- 2026-11-17: Yahoo Finance's ANT history page shows "Pending IPO Price" and "There are no [prices] in the selected time period." It has no rows and no data file behind it yet. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/ANT/history/)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 10 days. Pricing is expected 18 Nov, the first trade 19 Nov, and resolution comes at the 1:00 p.m. ET close on 27 Nov, after 6 sessions.

(b) **Latest value from the resolution source:** None. As of 17 Nov 2026, Yahoo Finance shows "Pending IPO Price" with no data rows. The proxies are:
- The IPO range is $70-78, and bankers have weighed pricing above it at a valuation of $1.5T or more, about $83 per share.
- The Hyperliquid pre-IPO perpetual was about $98.67 on 16 Nov.

(c) **If nothing changed:** The stock would price near the top of the range or slightly above, around $78-83. It would trade about where the pre-IPO perpetual sits, roughly $95-99.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** The AI and chip trade is in a sixth weekly decline, the Nasdaq fell 2.5% on 16 Nov, and the perpetual has drifted from about $116 to about $98. If that continues, the stock prices around $78-80 with a muted pop, settling near $85-92 by 27 Nov.

(e) **Historical variation:** SpaceX is the closest comparable.
- It closed day one up 19%, was up about 37% a week later, then gave back most of that within days.
- Swings of 15-20% over a few sessions were normal.
- For ANT over 6 sessions, the standard deviation is roughly 15-20% around the day-one level, on top of uncertainty about the day-one pop itself.

(f) **Experts and markets:**
- Demand is reported at 6x oversubscribed, with claims of 10-20x.
- About $26bn of strategic purchases are committed at the IPO price.
- Berenberg expects about $19bn of passive buying in the first month, plus pre-Nasdaq-100 positioning. This supports the price ahead of the inclusion test around day 7.
- The perpetual implies about $98. The SpaceX perpetual overshot its day-one close by about 7%, which suggests a fair value nearer $92-95.
- Polymarket buckets are noisy but lean toward a positive day-one move.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** A weak Nvidia report and a chip export shock crush the AI trade. The deal prices at $70, the greenshoe support breaks, and the stock ends around $60.
- **High:** Pricing comes in around $85 or higher, retail and index front-running produce a SpaceX-style squeeze, and the stock reaches $140-160 by 27 Nov.

My median is about $96: an IPO price of roughly $80 plus a pop of about 20%, with positive index flows offset by a weak macro backdrop.
